Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge

on this individual is attached herewith.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Sd) K. M. Bourne.
Deputy Commissioner
(Special Branch)

J. Van den Berg, Esq.,
Netherlands Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.I. Special Branch
REPORT
Date June 11, 1937
Communication dated 7.6.37 from the Netherlands Consulate
Subject General concerning B.A. Topas.
Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky Forwarded by J. Byrne

Enquiries show that Boris Abramovich Topas, Russian Jew,
was born on 1.3.1892 at Stretensk, Transbaikal Province, Siberia.
About 30 years ago he arrived in Harbin, Manchuria, where he was
engaged in commercial activities. Until 1925-6 he was connected
with M.A. Topas & Co, Manufacturers, Importers, and Exporters, 16
Birjevaia Street, Harbin, a well known firm in Manchuria. The
owners of this firm were his uncle M.A. Topas and his Cousin, the
late A.A. Naphtanovich.

In 1925 or 1926 B.A. Topas arrived in Shanghai and started
business under the name of B. Topas & Co. Ltd, Manufacturers,
Importers and Exporters, 64 Peking Road. At present he owns
three firms : Topas Transport & Storage Co, B.Topas Trading Co.
and Topas Land Investment Co. with offices at No. 11 Ezra Road..
In 1936 he joined as a partner the Silver Jubilee Publishing Co.
Ltd, 11 Ezra Road and is a Director and Secretary of this company.

Topas is one of the leading members of the Russian Jewish
community. In 1936 the All World Zionist Executive Committee
in Jerusalem appointed him their Emissary in China of which fact,
it is reported, the Palestine Government informed the British
Consulate-General in Shanghai. Shortly after Topas received this
post he organized the Jewish Communal Association of Shanghai, of
which he is Chairman. R.B. Bitker is the Secretary of this Asso-
ciation and members include Rabbi M. Ashkenazi and Rev. M.Brown.
All these persons are well known members of Jewish Community.
B.A. Topas is President of the Shanghai Zionist Association
"Kadimah", 110 Szechuen Road. He is also a member of the Shanghai
Jewish Club, 35 Moulmein Road. This Club admits as members Jews
of all countries, including Soviet citizens. Some of the members
have been the subjects of police reports in connection with poli-

报告
日期：1937年6月11日
事由：荷兰领事馆1937年6月7日来文
主题：关于 B.A. 托帕斯的一般情况。
撰写人：D.S. 切列姆尚斯基 转呈人：J. 伯恩

经查，鲍里斯·阿布拉莫维奇·托帕斯，俄籍犹太人，于1892年3月1日出生于西伯利亚外贝加尔省斯特列滕斯克（Stretensk）。约30年前，他抵达满洲哈尔滨，从事商业活动。直至1925-1926年，他一直与位于哈尔滨比热瓦亚街16号的 M.A. 托帕斯公司（M.A. Topas & Co，制造商、进出口商）有关联，该公司是满洲地区的一家知名商行。该公司的所有者为其叔父 M.A. 托帕斯及其表亲、已故的 A.A. 纳夫塔诺维奇（A.A. Naphtanovich）。

1925年或1926年，B.A. 托帕斯抵达上海，并以“B. 托帕斯有限公司”（B. Topas & Co. Ltd，制造商、进出口商）的名义开始经商，地址为北京路64号。目前，他拥有三家公司：托帕斯运输仓储公司（Topas Transport & Storage Co）、B. 托帕斯贸易公司（B.Topas Trading Co.）和托帕斯土地投资公司（Topas Land Investment Co），办公地点均位于爱多亚路11号。1936年，他作为合伙人加入位于爱多亚路11号的银禧出版有限公司（Silver Jubilee Publishing Co. Ltd），并担任该公司的董事兼秘书。

托帕斯是俄籍犹太人社群的主要成员之一。1936年，位于耶路撒冷的世界犹太复国主义执行委员会任命他为该会在华代表，据报巴勒斯坦政府已将此事通知英国驻上海总领事馆。托帕斯在接受此职后不久，组织了上海犹太社群协会（Jewish Communal Association of Shanghai），并担任主席。R.B. 比特克（R.B. Bitker）任该协会秘书，成员包括 M. 阿什肯纳齐拉比（Rabbi M. Ashkenazi）和 M. 布朗牧师（Rev. M.Brown）。这些人均为犹太社群中知名的成员。B.A. 托帕斯是位于四川北路110号的上海犹太复国主义协会“卡迪玛”（Kadimah）的主席。他也是位于慕尔鸣路35号的上海犹太俱乐部（Shanghai Jewish Club）的成员。该俱乐部接纳各国犹太人入会，包括苏联公民。部分会员曾因政治活

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

7946
6 37

No. 1868. SHANGHAI, 7th June 1937

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Mr Boris Abramovitch
TOPAS has applied to this Consulate for a visé for admission
into the Netherlands Indies

He is in possession of a passport issued by the Bureau of
Public Safety at Shanghai on the 21st May 1937 No. 8139/357372.

According to his passport he was born in Stretensk Russia,
about 45 years ago

Mr. Topas who is secretary of the Silver Jubilee Pub-
lishing Company Ltd , 11 Edward Ezra Road intends to make a
trip around the world on behalf of this company and to
travel via Hongkong, Macao, Manila, Saigon, Singapore, Batavia,
Bangkok, Port Said, Jerusalem, Marseilles, London, New York,
San Francisco, and thence to Shanghai.

Besides this secretaryship Mr. Topas has his own company
the Topas Transport & Storage Company also situated at 11 Edward
Ezra Road.

He stated that he has been residing in China for more
than 30 years whereas his private address in Shanghai is 1250
Avenue Joffre.

He intends to leave Shanghai about the 15th of this month
for Hongkong.

From my records I find that in the spring of 1931 Mr.
Topas was interested in the establishment of a hotel together
with various Soviet agents.

I should be much obliged to you if you would let me know,
if possible, whether anything is known against this person from
a political or moral point of view.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
〔签名〕
CONSUL

（左侧批注：SI / Ea-S）
（左侧印章：SPECIAL BRANCH / 83 / 8 JUNE 1937 / SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

Major K.M. Bourne,
Officer i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,

SHANGHAI. 20/6/37

电话挂号：HOLLANDIA

7946
6 37

第1868号。 上海，1937年6月7日

先生：

谨此告知，鲍里斯·阿布拉莫维奇·托帕斯先生已向本领事馆申请前往荷属东印度群岛的入境签证。

他持有上海公安局于1937年5月21日签发的护照，号码为 8139/357372。

根据其护照记载，他出生于俄罗斯斯特列滕斯克，年龄约45岁。

托帕斯先生是位于爱德华·爱多亚路11号的银禧出版有限公司的秘书，他打算代表该公司进行环球旅行，途经香港、澳门、马尼拉、西贡、新加坡、巴达维亚、曼谷、塞得港、耶路撒冷、马赛、伦敦、纽约、旧金山，随后返回上海。

除担任该秘书职务外，托帕斯先生还拥有自己的公司，即同样位于爱德华·爱多亚路11号的托帕斯运输仓储公司。

他声称已在中国居住超过30年，其在上海的私人住址为霞飞路1250号。

他计划于本月15日左右离开上海前往香港。

根据我的记录，我发现1931年春，托帕斯先生曾有兴趣与多名苏联代理人共同建立一家酒店。

如蒙告知，从政治或道德角度是否掌握对此人的任何不利信息，我将不胜感激。

此致
敬礼

〔签名〕
领事
